A little note for you

To you...

I still don't know your name, so I don't know what to call you yet. I don't really know how to say this without sounding weird, but I just wanted to say — your smile makes my world brighter, more than you probably realize. I've been wanting to message you, just in case you're feeling lonely. But I never really dared to... I'm just afraid of bothering you, or that you might get annoyed by me. Also, if you're ever feeling stressed, I really hope you can keep smiling. I don't want to see you stressed out. Maybe I'm just overthinking it, but please smile a lot, okay? Actually, I'm not very good at talking to people. So, if this makes you feel uncomfortable in any way, I'm really sorry. But you're really so beautiful, like an angel. I'm not lying.

— just had to tell you that 💕
